definitions.name: G0D.MOD
definitions.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b G0D.MOD -> a modulo b (a - b*floor(a/b))

definitions.name: G0D.SHIFT
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV 0 GET 1 COLLECT SV -1 DROP CONCAT
definitions.note: V -> same-length Vector of each lane's previous element, first lane repeating V[0]

definitions.name: G0D.RUNS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV G0D.SHIFT SUB [ 'D' BIND 0 1 D 0 EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN RV GROUP VALUES
definitions.note: numeric V -> Vector of its maximal runs of equal adjacent values, each run a Vector, in order

definitions.name: G0D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DK' BIND 1 DK RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DK DD DIV FLOOR DD MUL DK EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: G0D.BRACKET-DELTAS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'DC' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD DC GET ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opener and -1 per closer

definitions.name: G0D.BRACKET-STACK
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'x' ] [ 'BC' BIND 'BA' BIND BA BC 1 COLLECT CONCAT BA -1 DROP 2 COLLECT 1 0 BA -1 GET [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 'z' 'z' '(' '[' ] RECORD BC GET EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector left after cancelling adjacent matched pairs, with sentinel 'x' at the bottom (balanced iff equal to [ 'x' ])

definitions.name: G0D.BALANCED
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly balanced

definitions.name: G0D.GAPS
definitions.body: [ 'GE' BIND 1 0 GE NIL? SELECT ] MAP G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of the runs of consecutive NILs (each run a Vector of 1s)

definitions.name: G0D.ORDERS
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Vector of order Records

definitions.name: G0D.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over priced orders

definitions.name: G0D.QTY-BY-SKU
definitions.body: G0D.ORDERS 'QO' BIND QO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP QO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'QG' BIND QG KEYS QG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: G0D.WORDS
definitions.note: space-separated String -> Vector of its non-empty words

definitions.name: G0D.LOWER-WORDS
definitions.note: space-separated String -> Vector of its words in lower case

definitions.name: G0D.JOIN-WITH
definitions.body: 'SEP' BIND [ 'JX' BIND SEP JX 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS SEP CHARS LENGTH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: words sep G0D.JOIN-WITH -> the Strings joined with sep between them (words non-empty)
